duration_minutes.definition: Observed duration represented by one source event.

downtime_minutes.definition: Additive operational outage-impact estimate attributed to the event.
downtime_minutes.relationship: May overlap event duration and may exceed duration_minutes.

observed_minutes.definition: Total observed event duration for the daily machine grain.

downtime_minutes.relationship: Independent outage-impact estimate; not a partition of observed_minutes.

downtime_impact_ratio_pct.formula: round(downtime_minutes / observed_minutes * 100, 2) when observed_minutes > 0; otherwise null
downtime_impact_ratio_pct.definition: Outage-impact minutes per observed minute, expressed as an uncapped percentage. It is not availability or elapsed-time share.

prohibited_interpretations: downtime_minutes must be less than or equal to duration_minutes
downtime_minutes must be less than or equal to observed_minutes
